name: Workspace
description:
The windowed workspace: the routed `primary` view plus every open window from the
enclosing `WindowManagerProvider`, tiled, floating or maximised, with the dock. On phones
the focused window covers the screen and a switcher lists the rest. Reports its size to the
manager so new windows are placed inside it.
signature: ({ primary, primaryLabel, dock, reservePrimary, tileOrder, scopes, className, }: WorkspaceProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: dock
props.description: Show the dock of open windows (default true).

props.name: primary
props.description: The routed view. Render EntityHeader, WindowFrame.Body and WindowFrame.StatusBar.

props.name: primaryLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the primary window, normally the entity or page title.

props.name: reservePrimary
props.description:
Keep a column for the primary view beside tiled windows (default true). When false, tiled
windows fill the stage and the primary view shows only while none is tiled: for a page
that is entirely windows, such as a dashboard. Phone sheets are unchanged.

props.name: scopes
props.description:
The tenant scope the user is in and how to draw one (R14.4). Windows from another scope
show its chip in their app bar, and the dock groups windows by scope. Omit for a
product without scopes.

props.name: tileOrder
props.description:
Preferred order of tiled windows by id, from the start of the stage; unlisted windows
follow in the order they were opened. A window closed and reopened returns to its place.
Floating windows and the dock are unaffected.
